scanNote:
Bu — Coursebook'ning OLD MUQOVASI. Bet raqami yo'q, mashq ham yo'q.

Muqovaning o'ng qismi och yashil rangda, chap qismida to'rtta rangli surat ustma-ust joylashgan:
• yuqorida — suv ustida uchayotgan oq boshli burgut (panjalari cho'zilgan)
• undan pastda — oq yog'och shamol tegirmoni
• o'rtada — qamishzor orasida qayiqda baliq ovlayotgan shlyapali erkak va yonidagi bola
• pastda — suv ostidagi pushti-binafsha tropik baliq

Matn:
• o'ng yuqorida yoy shaklida pushti harflar bilan 'Beginner' va oq nur porlashi
• 'C O U R S E B O O K' — pushti harflar, keng oraliq bilan
• 'ENTERPRISE' — juda katta OQ harflar
• 'Virginia Evans - Jenny Dooley' — mualliflar (chap pastda)
• katta pushti '1' raqami
• pastda Express Publishing logotipi (kamalak ustidagi ochiq kitob)

⚠ Logotip ustida kichik qora to'rtburchak yorliq bor — ehtimol soxtalikka qarshi gologramma. Skanerda yozuvi aniq o'qilmaydi.

⚠ Mualliflar Workbook va Grammar Book bilan bir xil: Virginia Evans va Jenny Dooley.

exercises.instructionEn: ENTERPRISE 1 - COURSEBOOK - Beginner. Virginia Evans - Jenny Dooley. Express Publishing.
exercises.instructionUz: ENTERPRISE 1 - DARSLIK - Boshlovchilar uchun. Virjiniya Evans - Jenni Duli. Express Publishing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — KITOBNING OLD MUQOVASI.

  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami ham yo'q.


MUQOVADAGI MATN:

  Beginner            — daraja
  COURSEBOOK          — kitob turi
  ENTERPRISE          — seriya nomi
  1                   — bosqich raqami
  Virginia Evans -
     Jenny Dooley     — mualliflar
  Express Publishing  — nashriyot


⚠ 'ENTERPRISE' SO'ZI NIMA DEGANI:

  'an enterprise' ikki ma'noda:

     1) TAShABBUS, jasorat, dadillik
     2) KORXONA, tadbirkorlik

  ⚠ Kitob nomida BIRINChI ma'no nazarda
  tutilgan: til o'rganish — jasorat
  talab qiladigan ish.

  ⚠ 'enterprising' (sifat) = tashabbuskor,
  uddaburon.


⚠ 'BEGINNER' — DARAJA:

  'begin' (boshlamoq) + '-er'
     = boshlovchi

  ⚠ 'begin' da 'n' IKKILANADI: beginNer
  (urg'u oxirgi bo'g'inda bo'lgani uchun).

  ⚠ Enterprise seriyasi TO'RT bosqichli:
     Enterprise 1 — Beginner
     Enterprise 2 — Elementary
     Enterprise 3 — Pre-Intermediate
     Enterprise 4 — Intermediate

  ⚠ Bu ma'lumot orqa muqovada aytilgan:
  'the first in a FOUR-LEVEL series'.


⚠ MUALLIFLAR:

  Virginia Evans va Jenny Dooley —
  Express Publishing nashriyotining
  eng mashhur mualliflari.

  ⚠ Uchala kitobimiz ham (Coursebook,
  Workbook, Grammar Book) shu ikki
  muallifniki.

  ⚠ Ismlar orasida DEFIS emas, TIRE
  qo'yilgan: 'Evans - Dooley'.


MUQOVADAGI TO'RT SURAT:

  1) OQ BOShLI BURGUT (bald eagle)
     Suv ustida uchmoqda, panjalari
     cho'zilgan — baliq ovlayapti.
     ⚠ AQShning davlat ramzi.

  2) ShAMOL TEGIRMONI (windmill)
     Oq yog'och tegirmon.
     ⚠ Angliyaning Norfolk hududi va
     Gollandiya uchun xos.

  3) BALIQChILAR (fishing)
     Qamishzorda qayiqda o'tirgan shlyapali
     erkak va bola.

  4) TROPIK BALIQ
     Suv ostidagi pushti-binafsha baliq.

  ⚠ To'rt surat TABIAT va SAYOhAT
  mavzusini bildiradi — kitobning ruhiga
  mos.


⚠ NEGA MUQOVADA RASM MUHIM:

  Muqova kitobning MAVZUSINI oldindan
  aytadi. Bu — 154, 156, 160, 162-betlardagi
  'Pre-reading Activity' mashqlari bilan
  bir xil g'oya: rasmga qarab mazmunni
  taxmin qilish.


⚠ 'A COVER' — KITOB QISMLARI:

     the front cover  = old muqova
     the back cover   = orqa muqova
     the spine        = kitob tikilgan qirrasi
     the title page   = titul varag'i
     the contents     = mundarija


⚠ QORA YORLIQ:

  Logotip ustida kichik qora to'rtburchak
  bor — ehtimol soxtalikka qarshi
  GOLOGRAMMA yorlig'i.

  ⚠ Skanerda yozuvi aniq o'qilmaydi,
  shuning uchun taxmin sifatida yozildi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an enterprise = tashabbus; korxona
  enterprising  = tashabbuskor
  a beginner    = boshlovchi
  a level       = daraja, bosqich
  an author     = muallif
  a publisher   = nashriyot
  a cover       = muqova
  an eagle      = burgut
  a windmill    = shamol tegirmoni
  to fish       = baliq ovlamoq
  a reed        = qamish
  tropical      = tropik

points.noteUz:
⚠ 'an enterprise' = TASHABBUS, jasorat
(kitob nomida shu ma'noda); yana KORXONA.

⚠ 'a beginner' = 'begin' + '-er'.
'n' IKKILANADI: beginNer.

⚠ 'a coursebook' = 'course' + 'book' =
darslik.

⚠ Uchala kitobimiz ham (Coursebook,
Workbook, Grammar Book) shu ikki
muallifniki.

⚠ 'an author' = muallif;
'to write' → 'a writer' ham deyish mumkin,
lekin kitob mualliflari uchun 'author'
aniqroq.

points.en: The series has four levels: Beginner, Elementary, Pre-Intermediate, Intermediate.
points.uz: Seriya to'rt bosqichli: Beginner, Elementary, Pre-Intermediate, Intermediate.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Orqa muqovada aytilgan: 'the first in a
FOUR-LEVEL series'.

⚠ 'pre-' = OLDIN (154-betdagi 'pre-reading'
kabi).

⚠ 'four-level' — defis bilan, 'level'
BIRLIKDA.

points.en: The cover shows an eagle, a windmill, people fishing and a tropical fish.
points.uz: Muqovada burgut, shamol tegirmoni, baliqchilar va tropik baliq tasvirlangan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ To'rt surat TABIAT va SAYOHAT mavzusini
bildiradi.

⚠ Oq boshli burgut — AQSh ramzi;
shamol tegirmoni — Angliya (Norfolk) va
Gollandiya uchun xos.

⚠ Muqova kitob MAVZUSINI oldindan aytadi —
xuddi 'Pre-reading Activity' mashqlari kabi.
